plugins.name: PlantUML Diagrams
plugins.summary: Renders ```plantuml / ```puml fences via the real PlantUML engine (private JRE + plantuml-mit.jar, downloaded on install).

plugins.name: D2 Diagrams
plugins.summary: Renders ```d2 fences with Terrastruct's D2 — modern architecture/system diagrams from a single official binary.

plugins.name: Graphviz / DOT
plugins.summary: Renders ```dot / ```graphviz fences with the official Graphviz engine (checksum-pinned 15.1.0). No portable Linux build exists upstream.

plugins.name: Typst Snippets
plugins.summary: Renders ```typst fences — typeset math/tables/figures without LaTeX. Windows-only until the installer supports .tar.xz.

plugins.name: Vega-Lite Charts
plugins.summary: Renders ```vega-lite / ```vegalite JSON chart specs as real data visualizations via the official vl-convert binary.
